prompt: Create one complete, realistic, isolated armchair as a regular household product. Visible geometry and style: 饱满方块绗缝靠背与坐垫，宽扶手; 奶油休闲风. Use materials ['布艺'] and colors ['暖黄色']. Preserve ['方块绗缝软包、暖黄布艺质感']. Regularize temporary disorder with ['整理盖毯，对齐软包模块']. Simplify modeling complexity with ['简化绗缝凹陷深度，减少褶皱']: use clean broad surfaces, shallow orderly folds, separated non-intersecting parts, and avoid tangled fabric or dense tiny wrinkles. Complete occluded, back, side and underside regions using {'type': 'bilateral', 'completionRule': '沿座椅中线对称补齐扶手与软包块'} and ['补齐被遮挡的椅腿与另一侧扶手']. Texture rule: 方格绗缝软包纹理; 延续方格绗缝图案，保持均匀排布. Target plausible real-world dimensions are approximately 0.95 m wide, 0.90 m deep and 1.00 m high. Preserve the corresponding width-to-depth-to-height proportions. These are category-prior estimates rather than pixel measurements. Use conservative category structure, repeated modules, continuous closed geometry, and one 45-degree product view on a plain light background. Keep only the main object.
